events.name: Chicago Blackhawks at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Ryan Donato scored two more goals to help the Chicago Blackhawks beat the slumping Tampa Bay Lightning 3-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Donato scores 2 more goals as the Blackhawks beat the Lightning 3-2

headlines.description: — Troy Terry snapped a tie in the third period, and the Anaheim Ducks held off the Boston Bruins for a 7-5 victory on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Troy Terry snaps a third-period tie as the Ducks top the Bruins for a 7-5 win

headlines.description: — Linus Ullmark made 22 saves after allowing a goal on Philadelphia's first shot and the Ottawa Senators rallied to beat the Flyers 2-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Linus Ullmark makes 22 saves in the Senators' 2-1 victory over the Flyers

headlines.description: — Sidney Crosby had two goals and an assist for his fourth multipoint game of the season, Erik Karlsson and Evgeni Malkin each added two assists and the Pittsburgh Penguins topped the Florida Panthers 5-3 on Thursday night for their fourth consecutive...
headlines.shortLinkText: Sidney Crosby's two goals and an assist lead Penguins to 5-3 win over Panthers

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Emil Heineman scored twice, while Tony DeAngelo, Mathew Barzal and Simon Holmstrom each had a goal and an assist as the New York Islanders topped the Detroit Red Wings 7-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Islanders dominate Red Wings 7-2 behind Heineman's two goals

events.name: San Jose Sharks at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Macklin Celebrini had his second career hat trick and set up Will Smith's goal in overtime as part of a five-point game, and the San Jose Sharks picked up their first win of the season by beating the New York Rangers 6-5 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celebrini has a hat trick and a 5-point game, Sharks beat Rangers in OT for 1st win this season

events.name: Utah Mammoth at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Logan Cooley had a natural hat trick and added an assist — in the first period — in the Utah...
headlines.shortLinkText: Logan Cooley has natural hat trick in 1st period, Mammoth hold off Blues 7-4

headlines.description: — Cole Smith scored at 5:09 of the third period to lead the Nashville Predators to a 2-1 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cole Smith, Juuse Saros lead Predators over Canucks 2-1

headlines.description: — Joey Daccord made 32 saves and the Seattle Kraken beat the Winnipeg Jets 3-0 on Thursday night for their only regulation victory on a six-game trip.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joey Daccord makes 32 saves in the Kraken's 3-0 victory over the Jets

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Dallas Stars

headlines.description: — Adrian Kempe scored 37 seconds into overtime and the Los Angeles Kings beat Dallas 3-2 on Thursday night, handing the slumping Stars their fourth consecutive loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kempe's OT goal pushes Kings past slumping Stars 3-2

headlines.description: — Seth Jarvis had a short-handed goal and led off the shootout with the only goal in the tiebreaker, helping the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Colorado Avalanche 5-4 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jarvis has short-hander, lone shootout score in Hurricanes' 5-4 victory over Avalanche

headlines.description: — Vasily Podkolzin beat goalie Sam Montembeault with a backhander with 1:09 left and the Edmonton Oilers overcame a late two-goal deficit to edge the Montreal Canadiens 6-5 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Podkolzin breaks tie with 1:09 left, Oilers rally to beat the Canadiens 6-5
